def kth_largest(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """
    This function finds the k-th largest element in an unsorted list using the Min-Heap algorithm 
    with a time complexity of O(n log k).
    """
    import heapq
    
    if k < 1 or k > len(nums):
        raise ValueError("k is out of bounds")
    
    # Create a min-heap with the first k elements
    min_heap = nums[:k]
    heapq.heapify(min_heap)
    
    # Process the remaining elements
    for num in nums[k:]:
        if num > min_heap[0]:  # Only consider if current number is larger than the smallest in the heap
            heapq.heappop(min_heap)
            heapq.heappush(min_heap, num)
    
    # The root of the heap is the k-th largest
    return min_heap[0]

def kth_largest(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """
    This function finds the k-th largest element in an unsorted list using the Max-Heap algorithm,
    which has a time complexity of O(n + k log n), where n is the number of elements in the list.
    """
    import heapq

    if k < 1 or k > len(nums):
        raise ValueError("k is out of bounds")

    # Create a min-heap with the first k elements
    min_heap = nums[:k]
    heapq.heapify(min_heap)

    # Process the remaining elements
    for num in nums[k:]:
        if num > min_heap[0]:  # Only keep the largest k elements in the heap
            heapq.heapreplace(min_heap, num)

    return min_heap[0]  # The root of the min-heap is the k-th largest element

def kth_largest(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """
    This function finds the k-th largest element in an unsorted list using a Max-Heap approach.
    The time complexity is O(n + k log n), where n is the number of elements in the input list.
    """
    import heapq

    if k < 1 or k > len(nums):
        raise ValueError("k is out of bounds")

    # Create a max-heap by negating the numbers
    max_heap = [-num for num in nums]
    heapq.heapify(max_heap)

    # Pop the largest element k times
    for _ in range(k - 1):
        heapq.heappop(max_heap)

    return -heapq.heappop(max_heap)
